check_vasp_electronic_convergence: check if a VASP DFT calculation has converged electronically using the OSZICAR output file
count_scf_and_ionic_steps: count the total SCF and ionic steps from VASP OSZICAR output files in a directory
review_converged_oszicar: review the converged_oszicar function to understand how it checks VASP electronic convergence with NELM and EDIFF thresholds
refactor_converged_oszicar: refactor the converged_oszicar function to support non-VASP DFT output formats
summarize_count_scf: summarize the count_scf function that parses OSZICAR files to tally electronic and ionic steps
